acceptance_criteria: `Workplane::midplane(a: &Workplane, b: &Workplane) -> Result<Workplane, KernelError>`, kernel-free in `datum.rs`, documented: `a` and `b` must be parallel (normals equal or opposite within `DATUM_TOLERANCE`); the result's `normal` is `a`'s unit normal, its `origin` is the midpoint between `a.origin` and its projection onto `b`, and its `x_dir` is `a`'s `x_dir` (unit, perpendicular to the normal). Coincident planes return a plane equal to `a`.

`Kernel::work_plane_tangent(&self, s, face: SubShape, toward: [f64; 3]) -> Result<Workplane, KernelError>`, documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`: for a cylindrical face, the plane tangent to the cylinder on the side `toward` points to. Only the component of `toward` perpendicular to the cylinder's axis is used; it becomes the plane's unit `normal`. `origin` is the projection of the model origin onto the plane; `x_dir` follows the `Workplane::from_point_normal` rule.

`Kernel::edge_midpoint(&self, s, edge: SubShape) -> Result<Point3, KernelError>`, documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`: the point at half the edge's arc length (doc comment cites OCCT's reference documentation for the length method used, e.g. `GCPnts_AbscissaPoint`).
New shim code is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` call is in `ffi` with a SAFETY comment.

Tests, points and directions within 1e-9: midplane (no OCCT), tangent (behind occt) on make_cylinder([5, 5, 0], 3, 10), edge midpoint (behind occt) on box edge, half-disc arc and cylinder top circle; the input solids are unchanged afterwards (same volume and face count).

Errors, each with a test and never a panic, all `InvalidInput`: midplane of non-parallel planes (`Workplane::XY` and `Workplane::XZ`) or of an invalid plane (zero normal); `work_plane_tangent` on a non-cylindrical face (a box face), on an edge or vertex, with an index out of range, or with `toward` zero, non-finite, or parallel to the axis ((0, 0, 1)); `edge_midpoint` on a face or vertex, or with an index out of range.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
